lines.t: Why the sky so blue? Why my heart feel cracked?
Why they script my mind, tryna chain me to the track?
Why they feed these kids poison through a glowing screen?
Why my earliest dreams feel more real than my teens?
Why the chalk on the pavement mark another lost son?
Why they hashtag tears, then they scroll and they run?
Why I look at my brother, see a threat, not kin?
Why this world teach lose while You talk ‘bout win?
Why the lies feel safe, but the truth feel hard?
Why I cover up pain, play the fearless card?
Why these thoughts from the sandbox still hit raw?
Why the scripts they wrote never matched Your law?
Why the sky so blue? Why my heart feel cracked?
Why they script my mind, tryna chain me to the track?
Why the room so cold when the hate push back?
Why did YAH have David give it to the Choir Director like that?
Why the drums go loud when the secrets hit?
Why the tears in the dark got a holy grit?
Why this southside cry sound just like a psalm?
Why the storm in my chest turn to worship and calm?
Why the poor stay broke while the rich talk love?
Why they quote Your name, but they never look up?
Why a child in war, why a gun in his hand?
Why they profit off the blood, call it “building the land”?
Why the suit in the tower got a shark-fin smile?
Why the mom on the floor pray the rent for a while?
Why the food in the trash could’ve fed ten more?
Why a locked glass door guard an empty store?
Why I sense fake love when I read this room?
Why the brightest lights hide the deepest gloom?
Why the loudest “faith” got the softest spine?
Why Your quiet voice cut the loudest line?
Why? Why? Why?
Why did YAH have David give it to the Choir Director, make the whole choir cry?
Why? Why? Why?
Turn the beat to an altar, let the whole block ask “Why?”
Why the ones with Bibles got the sharpest knives?
Why they sacrifice hearts just to guard their lives?
Why they dress up pride and they call it “right”?
Why they flee Your word but they love that mic?
Why the mask fit tight when the hurt run deep?
Why the sleep so light when the secrets creep?
Why this anger in me feel older than time?
Why the chains on my soul feel linked to the crime?
Why YahuShua talk soft, but He cut so deep?
Why the thought of His eyes never let me sleep?
Why the things in The Volumes hit a nerve I hide?
Why the truth in those lines split my heart and pride?
Why the deep things whispered in the secret place
Turn a hardened face to a child in grace?
Why the sky so blue? Why my heart feel cracked?
Why they script my mind, tryna chain me to the track?
Why the room so cold when the hate push back?
Why did YAH have David give it to the Choir Director like that?
Why the bass so heavy when conviction falls?
Why the hood feel small when Your presence calls?
Why my “why” start wild but it ends in peace?
Why my war in the mirror start to find release?
Why I brag on the deep when I’m dust and breath?
Why You pull me from the script that was writ for death?
Why You send me to the block with a scroll and pen?
Why You tell me, “Ask why,” then You heal me again?
Why my childhood questions, like a loop, come back,
When I sit with You still, let the armor crack?
Why the boy that I buried just to act grown hard
Start to weep when Your name hit the battle-scarred?
Why the tears taste sweet when they fall for real?
Why the wound show light when You start to heal?
Why the hardest streets still can feel Your touch?
Why a whisper from You overpowers so much?
Why? Why? Why?
Why did YAH have David give it to the Choir Director, make the pain testify?
Why? Why? Why?
Open up your inner-child, let YahuShua meet that “Why.”
